narrative.overview: TrackMarket is a tool people sit inside while markets move, so the interface behaves like a well-run trading desk: dense, quiet and precise. Data is the hero. The chrome is a set of cool, near-black neutrals that recede until a number changes, and colour is spent only where it carries meaning. Density is a feature. Rows are tight, labels are small and uppercase, and numerals are tabular so columns of prices line up. Hierarchy comes from weight, size and space rather than from colour or decoration: no gradients, glows, coloured side stripes or icon tiles. The look is dark by design, from the use scene: watching a screen for hours, often next to other trading tools.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral surfaces with one tonal step per layer (canvas, surface, raised)
Green and red reserved for price direction, always paired with ↑/↓ or a sign
One family (IBM Plex Sans) for everything, tabular numerals for every figure
Hairline borders and tonal layering instead of shadows
Fast, functional motion; nothing loops except loading skeletons

rules.name: The Meaning-Only Rule
rules.body: Green and red appear only when they say up or down (or destroy). A button, badge or heading is never coloured for emphasis.

rules.name: The No-Gray-On-Color Rule
rules.body: Text on a tinted surface uses Ink or the surface's own hue, never a mid-gray.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change (prices, changes, volumes, totals, times) is set with tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure comes from 1px lines and tonal steps. A coloured border thicker than 1px never marks a card, row or callout.

dos: Do keep green and red for direction and destructive actions, and pair them with ↑/↓ or a sign.
Do use the shared classes in src/components/ui.ts for buttons, inputs and segmented controls.
Do set every changing number with tabular-nums.
Do show a skeleton, not a placeholder price, until a real quote arrives.
donts: Don't add a brand accent colour, gradient, or glow; the previous violet gradient accents were removed deliberately.
Don't use coloured left stripes, icon tiles above headings, or grids of identical icon cards.
Don't render text below 11px or use Ink Faint for readable text.
Don't use emoji or Unicode glyphs as icons.
